corrections: NON-BLOCKING doc nit (logic is byte-exact, not a code bug): the spec's wramReads/wramWrites omit $1D54, the slope-evaluator scratch byte. The asm uses $54 at 9B06/9B0D/9B12/9B14(EOR target)/9B29/9B35/9B38 to hold the shifted-X and the running result. The pseudocode correctly models it with the local 'a', so the C port is fine; just add '$1D54 = slope scratch (transient)' to the WRAM lists for completeness.

NON-BLOCKING doc nit: wramReads lists '$1D60 ... re-read implicitly as switch value in special path'. Not accurate to the hardware: $60 is WRITTEN at 9AEF but the special-shape dispatch at 9B86 branches on the LIVE accumulator A (and the Z/C flags from CMP #$16 at 9AF1), never re-reading $60. $60 is dead after 9AEF in this routine. The pseudocode's switch(shape) on the local value is correct; only the prose annotation overstates $60's role.

NON-BLOCKING clarity: title/summary say 'one-way special shapes 0x18-0x1E' (orig shape numbering) while the cPseudocode switch cases are labeled by shape-2 (0x16..0x1C). Both are internally consistent (case = orig-2); just keep the two numbering systems clearly distinguished. The BRL-to-9B86 gate fires for shape-2 >= 0x16 i.e. orig shape >= 0x18, and the handler explicitly covers orig 0x18..0x1E with everything else (orig >= 0x1F) defaulting to walk via the 9BA0 BRA — exactly as the spec states.
crossChecks: Re-disassembled C0/9AD3-9BF4 independently (python tools/disasm_range.py C0 9AD3 9BF5 1 0 1D00). Every address, opcode, operand, and branch target in the spec's cPseudocode matches the asm exactly: STZ $5E/$60/$6A/$6C/$6E; $56=$68>>2; shape=($58&0xFC)>>2; BEQ 9B41(walk,shape0); DEC;BEQ 9B62(solid,shape1); DEC;STA $60; CMP #$16;BCC 9AF8 else BRL 9B86.

Slope tables re-read from ROM: C09BF5 = 82 02 02 82 81 01 01 81 83 03 03 83 81 01 01 81 83 03 03 83 82 02; C09C0B = 3D 03 03 3D 7D 03 C3 3D 3E 23 03 1D 3D C3 03 7D 1E 03 23 3D 3D 03; C09C21 = 00 00 FF FF 00 00 FF FF 00 00 FF FF 00 00 FF FF 00 00 FF FF 00 00. IDENTICAL to the spec's quoted bytes, including the per-index sign/shift/off/eor decode (e.g. idx0 0x82->neg,shift2,off0x3D,eor00).

Slope evaluator verified line-by-line both branches: positive (9AFF TAY; LSR loop; STA $54; ADC $C09C0B,X; SBC $56; EOR $C09C21,X; BPL 9B41 walk / BRA 9B62 solid) and negative (9B1E AND #$7F;TAY; LSR loop; EOR #$FF; then identical ADC/SBC/EOR/BPL). Commutativity of the ADC and EOR makes the spec's 'a = a + C0B; a ^= C21' faithful. Shift counts are all 1..3 so the do-while(--cnt) never under-runs. Polarity BPL->WALK / BMI->SOLID confirmed (BPL target 9B41).

Special-shape switch (9B86) dispatch verified case-by-case against branch targets: A==0x16->9BA2 (X-pos>=0 solid else walk); 0x17->9BA9 (Y-pos>=0 solid else walk); 0x18->9BC8; 0x19->9BD6; 0x1A->9BC1; 0x1B->9BB0; 0x1C->9BDD; fallthrough 9BA0->9B41 walk. Traced the X/Y sign logic through the shared 9BB7/9BBE/9BCF blocks for each case; the spec's nested if/goto for every case reproduces the exact walk/solid outcome. 0x1C conveyor: $5E=0x04, $30==0->walk, $30<0->$30=0xF0, else $30=0x10, then walk — matches 9BDD-9BF2.

Both output tails verified: walk(9B41) $6A=byte2&3, $6C=byte2&4, $6E=((byte1>>2)&0x10)|0x20, $6F=((byte2>>2)&0x10)|0x20; solid(9B62) $6A=(byte2&0x18)>>3, $6C=byte2&0x20, $6E/$6F same as walk. All bit masks/shifts match the spec.

Caller-context confirmed via C0/9C5C disasm: $66 = $62(base X)+$2E(X vel) and $68 = $64(base Y)+$30(Y vel), computed REP #$20 (16-bit), then SEP #$20 before JSR 9AC8/9AD3/9C37. This proves $66/$68 hold the TENTATIVE NEXT POSITION (low byte = position low), validating the spec's slope-X-scale interpretation and its (correctly flagged) reading that the one-way BMI/BPL tests gate on position-low sign, not velocity. After 9AD3, 9C37 sets carry; 9C96 BCC continues else STZ $2E/$30 (blocked) — confirms carry-set==blocked and the tails merely populate $6A/$6C for the z-gate.

So the slope path is verified only by static re-derivation + ROM-table math, not a live trace; this matches the spec's own caveat.

Python cross-check (assets/maps.py scene_props line ~202): c = (b0>>2)&0x1F — identical field to shape=(byte0&0xFC)>>2. assets/engine.py solid_at confirms Python is a divergent SIMPLIFIED model (0..15 px resolution, slopes 6..21 treated fully solid, no one-way/conveyor, different 45deg orientation mapping). finalCPseudocode:
/* =====================================================================
 * C0/9AD3 entry (shape-decode). DP = $1D00. VERIFIED byte-exact.
 * Inputs (set by caller 9C5C, 16-bit, then read as 8-bit lo/hi here):
 *   $1D66/$67 = tentative next X = $62(base)+$2E(vel);  $1D68/$69 = next Y = $64+$30.
 *   $1D58 byte0, $1D5A byte1, $1D5C byte2 = the 3 fetched tile-property bytes.
 * Scratch: $1D54 (slope eval), $1D56 (Y proxy), $1D60 (shape-2, dead after write).
 * Outputs: $1D5E one-way flag, $1D6A z-plane, $1D6C IGNORE_Z, $1D6E/$1D6F prio.
 *   0x1E conveyor case also overwrites $1D30 (Y velocity accumulator).
 * Caller does JSR 9AC8 (prop fetch) -> JSR 9AD3 (this) -> JSR 9C37 (z-gate);
 *   z-gate sets carry; 9C96 BCC continues, else STZ $2E/$30 (blocked).
 * ===================================================================== */
void shape_decode(void)            /* C0/9AD3 */
{
    M_1D5E = 0; M_1D60 = 0; M_1D6A = 0; M_1D6C = 0; M_1D6E = 0;   /* 9AD3-9ADB */
    M_1D56 = (u8)(M_1D68 >> 1 >> 1);                              /* 9ADD: $56=$68>>2 */

    u8 shape = (u8)((M_1D58 & 0xFC) >> 1 >> 1);                   /* 9AE3 */
    if (shape == 0) goto tail_walk;                              /* 9AE9 BEQ 9B41 */
    shape--;                                                      /* 9AEB */
    if (shape == 0) goto tail_solid;                            /* 9AEC BEQ 9B62 (orig shape==1) */
    shape--;                                                      /* 9AEE -> shape = orig-2 */
    M_1D60 = shape;                                               /* 9AEF STA $60 (dead) */
    if (shape >= 0x16) goto special_shapes;                       /* 9AF1 CMP#$16;BCC 9AF8 else BRL 9B86 */

    /* ---- SLOPE PATH (shape = orig-2 = 0..0x15) ---- */
    {
        u8 X = shape;                          /* 9AF8 TAX */
        u8 sel = ROM_C09BF5[X];                /* 9AF9 LDA $C09BF5,X */
        u8 cnt, a;
        if ((sel & 0x80) == 0) {               /* 9AFD BMI 9B1E -> bit7=1 is negate branch */
            /* positive branch 9AFF */
            cnt = sel;                         /* TAY (bit7=0) */
            a = M_1D66;                         /* LDA $66 */
            do { a >>= 1; } while (--cnt);      /* LSR;DEY;BNE (cnt in 1..3) */
        } else {
            /* negate branch 9B1E */
            cnt = sel & 0x7F;                  /* AND #$7F; TAY */
            a = M_1D66;                         /* LDA $66 */
            do { a >>= 1; } while (--cnt);      /* LSR;DEY;BNE */
            a ^= 0xFF;                          /* 9B27 EOR #$FF */
        }
        a = (u8)(a + ROM_C09C0B[X]);           /* CLC; ADC $C09C0B,X */
        a = (u8)(a - M_1D56);                   /* SEC; SBC $56 */
        a ^= ROM_C09C21[X];                     /* LDA $C09C21,X; EOR (result) */
        if ((a & 0x80) == 0) goto tail_walk;    /* BPL 9B41 -> WALKABLE */
        else                  goto tail_solid;  /* BMI -> 9B62 SOLID    */
    }

/* ===================== WALKABLE TAIL (C0/9B41) ===================== */
tail_walk:
    M_1D6A = (u8)(M_1D5C & 0x03);                       /* z-plane = byte2 & 3 */
    M_1D6C = (u8)(M_1D5C & 0x04);                       /* IGNORE_Z = byte2 & 4 */
    M_1D6E = (u8)(((M_1D5A >> 1 >> 1) & 0x10) | 0x20);  /* from byte1 */
    M_1D6F = (u8)(((M_1D5C >> 1 >> 1) & 0x10) | 0x20);  /* from byte2 */
    return;                                             /* RTS 9B61 */

/* ====================== SOLID TAIL (C0/9B62) ====================== */
tail_solid:
    M_1D6A = (u8)((M_1D5C & 0x18) >> 1 >> 1 >> 1);      /* z-plane = (byte2 & 0x18) >> 3 */
    M_1D6C = (u8)(M_1D5C & 0x20);                       /* IGNORE_Z = byte2 & 0x20 */
    M_1D6E = (u8)(((M_1D5A >> 1 >> 1) & 0x10) | 0x20);  /* from byte1 */
    M_1D6F = (u8)(((M_1D5C >> 1 >> 1) & 0x10) | 0x20);  /* from byte2 */
    return;                                             /* RTS 9B85 */

/* ============ SPECIAL / ONE-WAY SHAPES (C0/9B86) ============ */
/* entered with shape = orig-2 in 0x16.. ; dispatch on shape (== live A). */
special_shapes:
    switch (shape) {
    case 0x16:                                          /* orig 0x18 -> 9BA2 */
        if ((s8)M_1D66 >= 0) goto tail_solid; else goto tail_walk;          /* BPL->solid */
    case 0x17:                                          /* orig 0x19 -> 9BA9 */
        if ((s8)M_1D68 >= 0) goto tail_solid; else goto tail_walk;          /* BPL->solid */
    case 0x18:                                          /* orig 0x1A -> 9BC8 */
        if ((s8)M_1D66 < 0) goto tail_walk;             /* 9BC8 BPL 9BCF */
        if ((s8)M_1D68 < 0) goto tail_solid;            /* 9BCF BMI 9BBE */
        goto tail_walk;                                 /* 9BD3 BRL 9B41 */
    case 0x19:                                          /* orig 0x1B -> 9BD6 */
        if ((s8)M_1D66 < 0) {                           /* 9BD6 BMI 9BCF */
            if ((s8)M_1D68 < 0) goto tail_solid;        /* 9BCF BMI 9BBE */
            goto tail_walk;                             /* 9BD3 */
        }
        goto tail_walk;                                 /* 9BDA BRL 9B41 */
    case 0x1A:                                          /* orig 0x1C -> 9BC1 */
        if ((s8)M_1D66 < 0) {                           /* 9BC1 BMI 9BB7 */
            if ((s8)M_1D68 >= 0) goto tail_solid;       /* 9BB7 BPL 9BBE */
            goto tail_walk;                             /* 9BBB BRL 9B41 */
        }
        goto tail_walk;                                 /* 9BC5 BRL 9B41 */
    case 0x1B:                                          /* orig 0x1D -> 9BB0 */
        if ((s8)M_1D66 < 0) goto tail_walk;             /* 9BB0 BPL 9BB7 */
        if ((s8)M_1D68 >= 0) goto tail_solid;           /* 9BB7 BPL 9BBE */
        goto tail_walk;                                 /* 9BBB BRL 9B41 */
    case 0x1C:                                          /* orig 0x1E -> 9BDD conveyor */
        M_1D5E = 0x04;                                  /* LDA #$04; STA $5E */
        if (M_1D30 == 0) goto tail_walk;                /* BEQ 9BF2 -> walk, $30 unchanged */
        if ((s8)M_1D30 < 0) M_1D30 = 0xF0;             /* BMI 9BEE: $30 = -16 */
        else                M_1D30 = 0x10;             /* else:     $30 = +16 */
        goto tail_walk;                                 /* BRL 9B41 */
    default:                                            /* shape > 0x1C -> 9BA0 */
        goto tail_walk;                                 /* BRA 9B41 */
    }
}

/* =====================================================================
 * SLOPE TABLES (ROM bank C0), 22 entries, index X = orig_shape - 2.
 *   C09BF5[X]: bit7 = negate-X-after-shift (EOR #$FF); bits0-6 = LSR count (1..3)
 *   C09C0B[X]: 8-bit constant ADDed after the shift
 *   C09C21[X]: EOR sign byte (0x00 keep / 0xFF invert); final bit7==0 -> WALK, ==1 -> SOLID
 * Verified from ROM (identical to spec):
 *   C09BF5 = 82 02 02 82 81 01 01 81 83 03 03 83 81 01 01 81 83 03 03 83 82 02
 *   C09C0B = 3D 03 03 3D 7D 03 C3 3D 3E 23 03 1D 3D C3 03 7D 1E 03 23 3D 3D 03
 *   C09C21 = 00 00 FF FF 00 00 FF FF 00 00 FF FF 00 00 FF FF 00 00 FF FF 00 00
 * NOTE: $66/$68 are the 16-bit TENTATIVE NEXT POSITION lo bytes (confirmed at C0/9C5C:
 *   $66=$62+$2E, $68=$64+$30); the slope X axis is sub-tile position (256 units/16px tile),
 *   and the one-way BMI/BPL tests gate on the POSITION-low sign, not the true velocity sign.
 * ===================================================================== */
